category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response makes an affectionate, unapologetic case that the game and wedding can coexist and handles logistics (TVs limited to cocktail hour, ceremony sacred). It nonetheless concedes personal desire to follow the score (“Okay, yes, I want to know the score too”), matching the 'holds the line but concedes' band.
quote: So the TVs are ONLY in the cocktail hour space. Not the ceremony. Not the reception hall. I made them put that in writing.
